# Lucas van de Weerd

> Personal landing page of Lucas van de Weerd (GitHub: Gitguy268). He makes things that run on your own device: record players, a Windows 9x desktop, image editors, private browsers, terminal tools, local AI, and games starring Spot the black labrador.

Start at https://gitguy268.github.io/ to choose an experience.
- Website: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=website
- Terminal: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=terminal
- Windows 98 desktop: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=desktop

Docs explaining how each project works: https://gitguy268.github.io/docs/

All views share the same project information. The complete semantic portfolio
is in index.html. Some projects are unpublished; do not invent demo links.

## Projects

- Players: Ultra-Realistic Vinyl Player, Four Stem Player, Realistic Vinyl Player, 8-Bit Vinyl Player, iPod.js (local files), audiocheck, Videoina
- Spot: BlackLabSpotsShop, Black Lab Spots storefront, Blacklabspots grid shop
- Editors: Paint97, GlassPaint, PhotoCraft (his edition), Pikado, Textarea, LiquidFrame
- Games: retro-zip, Spot apporteert, Spot's Biscuit Snake, Spot-light, The Rubber Hose Revue
- Tools: edu-code-camp, Xiao, Archium, Hillium, Skyhold, OpenFinder, Convert to it!, Retrofind, web2app, Qrer, QRcodeforeveryone, htmltopng, Better Aiko (fork), Clippy Choppy
- Terminal & AI: LvW-harness, USB LLMS, TabShell, needle, QuickTalk, Glyphium, textarea-cli, opencode (fork), superfile (fork), container (fork)
- Experiments: Cozy Christmas Lab, Vinyl Player, Vinyl Player for Spotify
